1432-4613-6218.easyPrerequisites:
Pheres-Band Tromper doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Ioreth of the Healing House is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
1432-4613-6218.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1432-4613-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper using Ioreth of the Healing House's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Ioreth of the Healing House's ability by tapping it, untapping Pheres-Band Tromper
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

413-1981-6458.easyPrerequisites:
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
413-1981-6458.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Thunder of Unity trigger.
Resolve the Thunder of Unity trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6273-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
1981-2415-6273-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

333-8095-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-8095-8207.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

2738-2921-4871-6026.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Field of Souls, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

757-1446-5087-5524.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
757-1446-5087-5524.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Viral Drake to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Destiny Spinner, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the other Angel on the battlefield

3259-6791-7917--185.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6791-7917--185.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Seluma, triggering both Breath of Fury and Seluma.
Resolve the Seluma trigger, returning an Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Angel returned in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6791-7917--185.notes: One of the two additional Angels must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard. If both chosen Angels have haste, then Tannuk can be omitted.

4644-5984-7791.description:
Activate Moonscarred Werewolf by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Moonscarred Werewolf.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Moonscarred Werewolf.
Repeat.

215-1322-5614.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
215-1322-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-3644-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Young Wolf
When Young Wolf dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Young Wolf
When Young Wolf dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Young Wolf enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
2034-3644-6972.notes: If Young Wolf starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-3921-4762-5902.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Winding Constrictor and Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-3992-7373.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Tellah
1618-2440-3992-7373.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Cyclical Evolution.
Cyclical Evolution triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Tellah triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Cyclical Evolution.
Repeat.
1618-2440-3992-7373.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Tellah. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

618-1430--112.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mirror Image that has haste. Choose to have Mirror Image enter as a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Put the oldest Kiki-Jiki into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat step 1 using the Mirror Image token instead.
618-1430--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must increase Mirror Image's toughness.

4094-5086-5183-5231-6824.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4094-5086-5183-5231-6824.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

3885-4050-5187-6518.description:
Cast Stinkweed Imp by paying {B} due to The Sibsig Ceremony.
When Stinkweed Imp enters, The Sibsig Ceremony and Guardian Project trigger.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Stinkweed Imp, adding {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, failing to destroy Stinkweed Imp as it's no longer on the battlefield and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Resolve the Guardian Project trigger, causing you to mill five cards and return Stinkweed Imp from your graveyard to your hand due to Stinkweed Imp's dredge ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2018-2511-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with base toughness 2 or greater that does not have flying.
2018-2511-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nontoken creature that doesn't have flying.
When the creature dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with a flying counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.

662-1978-5614.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 3 or greater.
662-1978-5614.description:
Cause Bighorner Rancher to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Bighorner Rancher.
Repeat from step 2.

527-1781-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
527-1781-1978.description:
Cause Selvala to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat from step 2.

884-2577-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
884-2577-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters, Ayara triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

261-4017-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-4017-4186.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

104-3188-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3188-3197.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-2457-6633-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

252-2511-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2743-6570-6618.description:
Cast Mnemonic Deluge by paying {6}{U}{U}{U}, exiling Relm's Sketching and casting three copies of it without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the three Relm's Sketching copies, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

2178-3817-4050-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
2178-3817-4050-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 5 from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Repeat.

2534-3817-5231-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Coercive Recruiter, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

2452-2577-2921.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
2452-2577-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.

372-1621-4142.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-1621-4142.notablePrerequisites: Wispweaver Angel exiled by Hostage Taker
372-1621-4142.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Hostage Taker and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Wispweaver Angel returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Hostage Taker to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Hostage Taker and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Hostage Taker and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

2557-2793-3743-4067-5089.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2557-2793-3743-4067-5089.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

1636-3690-5996.easyPrerequisites: Tarmogoyf Nest does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3690-5996.notablePrerequisites: Creatures and/or lands you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
1636-3690-5996.description:
Cast Sylvan Awakening by paying {2}{G}, causing all lands you control to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate any number of creatures and/or lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
When the Tarmogoyf enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

5149-5200-5832.easyPrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Sword of the Paruns.
5149-5200-5832.notablePrerequisites:
Joraga Treespeaker does not have summoning sickness, and has at least one level counter on it.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Joraga Treespeaker
5149-5200-5832.description:
Activate Joraga Treespeaker by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {1}, untapping Joraga Treespeaker.
Repeat.
5149-5200-5832.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

2478-4211-5660-5943.notablePrerequisites: One of the self-sacrificing artifacts must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
2478-4211-5660-5943.description:
Cast the self-sacrificing artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the self-sacrificing artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the self-sacrificing artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it, and paying other costs if necessary.
Repeat.

803-2511-5853.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
803-2511-5853.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Rat" chosen.
803-2511-5853.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Snail, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Arcane Adaptation, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

678-2557-4050-4151.manaNeeded: {2}{W}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
678-2557-4050-4151.description:
Cast Vishgraz either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Vishgraz enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating six 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vishgraz, adding {W}.
When Vishgraz dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Vishgraz from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Phyrexian Mites, adding {2}{B}{G}.
Repeat.

1601-1651-1799-2048-5359.notablePrerequisites: Illuminor Szeras does not have summoning sickness.
1601-1651-1799-2048-5359.description:
Activate Illuminor Szeras by tapping it and sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk, adding seven {B}.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Threefold Thunderhulk and a Gnome token, untapping Illuminor Szeras.
Repeat.

1363-2059-4026.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G}.
You control at least one additional creature.
Tradewind Rider and Elvish Piper do not have summoning sickness.
1363-2059-4026.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {G}.
Activate Elvish Piper by paying {G} and tapping it, putting Village Bell-Ringer from your hand onto the battlefield.
Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Village Bell-Ringer and another creature you control, returning Village Bell-Ringer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If you can produce at least one additional mana in step 1, this combo produces infinite mana.

2937-3184-4786.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures.
2937-3184-4786.description:
Activate Xenagos' first ability, adding at least {4}{R}{G}.
Activate Claws of Gix by paying {1} and sacrificing Xenagos.
Yomiji triggers, returning Xenagos from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Claws of Gix trigger, gaining 1 life.
Cast Xenagos for {2}{R}{G}.
Repeat.

1987-3075-3227-3573.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.You control at least two artifacts.
1987-3075-3227-3573.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.

232-586-2232-3168.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying {B}.
Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Priest of Urabrask from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying {R}.
Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Priest of Gix from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
